title: Excuse Me for Being a Cat!
titleEnglish: Excuse Me for Being a Cat!
synonyms: Excuse Me for Being a Cat!
synopsis: Shiraishi Yayoi was a relatively unremarkable school girl, although a little clumsy, before a experimental accident changed her life forever. She was forced against her will by her father, self-proclaimed genius physicist, Shiraishi Sensei into a teleporter with a cat , and like in the movie "The Fly", she combined with the cat. Now, whenever she gets excited about anything, a pair of cat ears and a tail pop into existence. In the "catgirl" form, she has super powers, but the major drawback is that she also behaves like a cat when presented with the proper stimuli, like the sight of mice. She also has a boyfriend, but her "problem" tends to interfere in their dates since her excitement inevitably leads to her transformation into a catgirl. (Source: Taruby)

title: Scavengers Another Sky
titleNative: スカバンジャーズ アナザースカイ
synopsis: In a hidden research facility known as the “Bus Stop,” a fearless crew of treasure hunters — Scavengers — embarks on dangerous missions into the Black Parade, a mysterious parallel world filled with untold riches. Their mission: to gather valuable loot and earn a million dollars for their freedom. But there’s a deadly twist. The Black Parade is home to a vengeful entity determined to protect its treasures at any cost. With weapons drawn, the Scavengers face high-octane action, paranormal threats, and mind-bending mysteries in this thrilling sci-fi adventure. As they explore an eerie world full of bizarre creatures and unexplainable forces, they must rely on their wits, weapons, and teamwork to survive. But the deeper they go, the more they realize that the true cost of their mission might be more than they ever expected. (Source: Titan Manga) Note: The one-shot got published on July 20th, 2022 on the magazine Young Champion Retsu, and due to the popularity of this work, it was decided to serialize it. The one-shot was numbered as the first chapter of the manga, and the first chapter of the serialization got numbered as the second chapter of the series.

title: Ruri no Houseki
synopsis: Mineral collecting is like a modern-day treasure hunt! Ruri, a high school girl who loves jewelry and accessories, gets into the world of mineral collecting, venturing into mountains, rivers, and caves. The first volume features numerous minerals, including quartz, garnet, pyrite, gold sand, and fluorite. The manga is full of fascinating scenes focusing on specialized tools such as a panning dish, hammer, and topographical maps. An authentic scientific adventure based on the author's solid knowledge of mineralogy! (Source: Harta, translated)

titleRomaji: Wang You: Wo Neng Jinghua Yiqie
synonyms: Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything
synopsis: Betrayed by his best friend, our protagonist loses everything: billions in wealth, his loved ones, and even his legs. In “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything,” he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with a burning desire for vengeance, he vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him. When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By getting into the game early and spending heavily, he can acquire a god-level skill known as "Evolve Everything." Now he prepares to exact his revenge. With his unmatched knowledge and newfound powers, he embarks on a journey to dominate the game and take back his rightful place in the world.

synopsis: Sara, a mermaid living in the modern world, has been dealing with yokai and humans alike as a “Trader.” To her, humans are merely clients—trusting them with her heart was never an option… One day, a mysterious young man named Sora wanders into her miniature garden. He doesn’t seem like an enemy, but there’s clearly something unusual about him. Sara offers him a deal. However, the one thing Sora truly desires turns out to be none other than Sara herself…!? A cohabitation romance filled with love and secrets begins—all starting from a single “deal”! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
